title: Legitimate Internship (Infosys)
text:
Infosys is inviting applications for its Summer Internship Program 2024.

Role: Software Engineering Intern
Duration: 2 months (May–June 2024)
Stipend: ₹20,000/month
Location: Bengaluru / Pune / Hyderabad

Eligibility:
- B.Tech / M.Tech students (2025 graduating batch)
- CGPA ≥ 7.0
- Strong fundamentals in Data Structures and Algorithms

How to Apply:
Visit campus.infosys.com and submit your application by 31st March 2024.

Selection Process: Aptitude Test → Technical Interview → HR Interview

No registration fee. No advance payment required.

For queries: internships@infosys.com

title: Legitimate Job Posting (LinkedIn Style)
text:
TCS is hiring for the role of Business Analyst — Entry Level

Location: Mumbai, India
Experience: 0–2 years
Salary: ₹4.5 LPA – ₹6 LPA

Job Description:
- Analyze business requirements and translate them into functional specifications
- Work with stakeholders across finance and operations teams
- Support project planning and documentation

Required Skills:
- Strong analytical and communication skills
- Proficiency in MS Excel and PowerPoint
- Basic understanding of SDLC

How to Apply:
Apply through ibegin.tcs.com or through our official LinkedIn page.

TCS will never ask candidates to pay any fees during the recruitment process.

title: Scholarship Opportunity
text:
The National Merit Scholarship Foundation is accepting applications for the 2024–25 academic year.

Award: Up to ₹1,00,000 per year
Eligibility: Students enrolled in accredited undergraduate programs
Criteria: Academic merit + financial need

How to Apply:
1. Complete the online application at nmsf.gov.in
2. Attach income certificate, bonafide letter, and marksheets
3. Applications close: 15th October 2024

No application fee. Shortlisted candidates will be interviewed by a committee.

For help: scholarship@nmsf.gov.in

title: Legitimate Remote Work Offer
text:
Flipkart is hiring Customer Support Associates — Work From Home

Role: Customer Support Associate (Voice + Chat)
Type: Full-time, Permanent
Shift: Rotational (9-hour shifts)
Salary: ₹18,000 – ₹22,000/month + incentives

Requirements:
- Minimum 12th pass
- Good communication skills in Hindi + English
- Own laptop/desktop with reliable internet

Application Process:
1. Apply at careers.flipkart.com
2. Complete online assessment
3. Video interview (scheduled by HR)

Flipcart does not charge any fee from applicants at any stage of the hiring process.

For queries, contact: jobs@flipkart.com
